affinity.notes: Hide, bone, wood, and feathers dominate without a visible elemental body treatment.

anatomy.notes: Squat reptilian body, tail, staff, and raised casting hand are legible.

archetype.notes: Support-controller does not communicate the intended five-phase warcourt sovereign duty.

counterplay.notes: Staff, raised hand, and ritual standard visibly cue a back-line caster or buffer worth prioritizing.

finish.notes: Convincing hide, bone, and feather textures.

framing.notes: Large ritual standard fills the frame without losing the body.

identity.notes: Reptilian tribal chieftain identifies the Saurian Tyrant form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3, not exact intended tier T5.
